source_verification_receipts.locator: Assignment and Observed Data, lines 185–199; Algorithm 1, lines 242–261; Theorem 3.2 and Corollary 3.3, lines 268–299
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes independent Bernoulli treatment indicators, separately fits the two arm-mean matrices by empirical-row-scaled SVD, and derives a rowwise treatment-effect matrix error bound; it does not state the proposal's predictable-mask effect-subspace result.

Assumption 2 requires normalized third moments, predictable-covariance mean and high-probability control, empirical covariance and plug-in approximation, dimension growth, and a variance floor; Theorem 3.3 yields simultaneous multiplier intervals after those conditions hold.

State a concise comparison of the logarithmic factors in the proposed frontier and Mehrotra et al.'s rowwise matrix-error bound so “same geometric scale” cannot be read as equality of full rates.
